songRequestPublic.title: Song queue
songRequestPublic.disabled: This channel doesn't have song requests turned on.
songRequestPublic.empty: The queue is empty. Be the first to request a song!

sr.text: Requests a song with a YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Deezer or Apple Music link, or by typing its name.

srNumber.text: Requests to the queue, by its number, a song from the background playlist.

wrongsong.text: Removes your last request from the queue, in case you got it wrong.

song.text: Says which song is playing, with the link.

queue.text: Shows the next songs and the link to the queue.

myqueue.text: Says where your requests are in the queue.

skipVote.text: Votes to skip the song that's playing (request or playlist); it's skipped with {{votes}} votes.

pl.text: Says which playlist is in the background and which number is playing.

plplay.text: With a name, sets that playlist as background (it plays when there are no requests). With #number it jumps right away to that song of the background playlist; if a request is playing, right after it. They can be combined: !plplay chill #19.

plstop.text: Stops the background playlist: when the queue is empty nothing plays. !plplay off works too.

plnext.text: Moves to the next song of the background playlist. It doesn't skip requests (use !skip).

plshuffle.text: The background playlist plays in random order (on) or in order (off); with nothing, it toggles.

pladd.text: Adds a song to a collaborative playlist. If only one is open, the playlist name isn't needed. Each playlist decides who can add.

skip.text: Skips the song that's playing (request or playlist), without a vote.

srremove.text: Removes the request at that queue position.

srpromote.text: Moves the request at that position to the front of the queue.

srapprove.text: Approves what is waiting for review by its number in the inbox; with no number, the oldest.

srreject.text: Rejects what is waiting for review by its number in the inbox; with no number, the oldest.

srmode.text: Changes the request mode instantly: open, playlists only, with review or closed. With nothing, says the current mode.

srban.text: With nothing, bans the song that's playing and skips it; with @user, bans that person.

videocover.text: The player shows the video or the cover, without stopping the music.

public.chatOn: Type the commands in the channel's chat on

mode.open: Requests are open: ask for any song you like.
mode.playlists: Only songs already in the channel's playlists are accepted, or by number with !sr #n.
mode.review: The channel's team reviews each request before it enters the queue. You'll be told in chat.
mode.closed: Requests are closed for now. You can still see what's playing with !song and the queue with !queue.
